normalization_plan.reason: _governance is a scoped setter argument only consumed by changeGovernance
_treasury is a scoped setter argument only consumed by changeTreasury
_operation is a scoped setter argument only consumed by changeOperationWallet
_newTemplate is the sole argument encoded by updateTemplate
_asset is only used to build the vault initializer calldata
_receiver is only meaningful within the flash loan flow
_amount is the flash loan principal parameter scoped to flashLoan/flashFee
_data is transparently forwarded in the flash loan and has no independent semantics
fee is a transient local derived from flashFee and consumed by flashLoan
result only carries the CREATE2 deployed address out of deployVault
salt is a constant-valued local supporting the deterministic deployment path
template is decoded solely to serve as the delegatecall target
_recipient is a scoped mint argument with no other usage
